measurement_amendment.approval: User explicitly approved finishing the described prospective measurement-rule amendment
measurement_amendment.scope: Only native positive-infinite SNR from an attached receiver is represented explicitly as unbounded; independently finite receiver fields remain measured
measurement_amendment.not_a_finite_measurement: sinr_db remains absent/NaN, never capped or replaced in raw measurement records
measurement_amendment.policy_input: Existing frozen causal imputer may supply SNR with explicit previous_measured/training_mean provenance; never measured guard evidence
measurement_amendment.guard_inputs: Measured throughput, BLER and RLC delay must still be finite; all thresholds and action logic unchanged
measurement_amendment.other_nonfinite_fields: NaN, negative infinity, malformed and other missing fields remain subject to the prior rejection/censoring rules
measurement_amendment.preservation: Old complete preflights and partial comparison remain unchanged; all 48 comparison rows are freshly executed under this amendment

historical_freeze.analysis_role: prospective bounded exploratory integrated evaluation, independent from all historical cohorts
historical_freeze.replication_rationale: 12 independent matched scenario-seed blocks across six strata, two seeds per stratum; four arms give 48 runs and 2160 radio windows. Resource-bounded estimation rather than a superiority-powered study. At n=12, an all-success run-level rate has two-sided exact 95% lower limit 0.735. Report interval width instead of claiming broad robustness.
historical_freeze.precision_target: Estimate paired run-level goodput and latency effects with bootstrap 95% intervals; no threshold tuning or sample-size stopping based on effects. Prior 24-block actuator variability is supplied for context, not treated as guard variance.

analysis_plan.role: exploratory estimation; no confirmatory superiority claim
analysis_plan.independent_unit: matched scenario-seed block; 12 blocks, four independently executed arms; radio windows are repeated observations
primary_service_estimates: mean protected goodput across 20 exposure radio windows
goodput retention relative to the same run's 15 pre-exposure radio windows
95th percentile finite observed exposure RLC SDU delay with missingness and outage counts separately
analysis_plan.latency_pair: guarded_policy minus policy, comparing each run's mean, p95 and p99 full local processing including logging
analysis_plan.timing_boundary: radio-window waiting excluded; command communication and scheduler readback combined unless separately instrumented; complete stage coverage reported
analysis_plan.uncertainty: 10,000 matched-block bootstrap resamples; paired mean differences; percentile 2.5/97.5 limits; deterministic seeds 20261026 plus comparison index; fewer than two blocks yields no confidence interval
analysis_plan.multiplicity: all intervals are exploratory pointwise 95% estimates; no simultaneous-coverage or familywise-significance claim; all twelve planned estimates reported
controller_outcomes: UNKNOWN windows and monotonic command-event intervals
baseline restoration and later verified nontrivial resumption
analysis_plan.harm: report guard harm-boundary activations and direction of matched service differences; no post hoc favorable-threshold selection
analysis_plan.missingness: unavailable proposals never become A0; nonfinite measured guard inputs are not imputed for admission; missing control records, incomplete measurements and failed controller outcomes retained

historical_freeze.acceptance: measurement completeness only; controller failures/lockout/skips are outcomes and never removed to improve performance
historical_freeze.retry_policy: no automatic retries; incomplete attempts are archived and require an infrastructure diagnosis

missingness_rule: Native-NaN windows are missing, excluded from available-window metric means and break recovery persistence. No imputed observations.
fault_rule: Real loopback command proxy: lost ack withheld after observed upstream ack; timeout request withheld after real handshake; mismatch changes actual wire parameter. Never alter stored acknowledgements/readback.
exploratory_gpre_rule: Mean of the three completed, consecutive measured windows immediately before first authorized action; retain within active episode. Calibration/admission and all numeric thresholds unchanged.
